description: Moonfall-original 141-node classless constellation talent tree, 47 connected talents per branch. Godot UI integration staged; UE5 parity pending.
rules: No character classes or locked branches
No upgrade cards or reroll choices
Automatically increased base stats remain separate from earned talent points
Spend points deliberately in persistent connected branches
Respec refunds spent talent points; does not change experience, levels or equipped items
141 talent nodes: 47 each in Might, Agility and Arcana; 14 tiers, open branches, full-tree respec only
Two talent points awarded per level gained; level one starts with zero unspent points
